script_text: Your ruling planet Sun is about to ignite your most ambitious sector, and this week changes everything for Leo. Monday through Wednesday, Mercury in your 10th House forms a trine with Jupiter, opening massive career doors — but watch for tension on Tuesday when Mars squares your Sun, making colleagues harder to read. Wednesday afternoon is your turning point as Venus sextiles your natal Sun and enters your 5th House, flooded by creative and romantic momentum that shifts your entire week. Thursday through Sunday brings intense pleasure and connection energy — you will feel magnetic, and a financial opportunity lands via networking before Friday. Saturday holds stunning date energy with Venus illuminating your 7th House ruling planet partnerships, while Sunday glows with confidence and new beginnings. Your best day is Wednesday because Venus enters your 5th House and Saturn stabilizes your career zone, amplifying everything. Your worst day is Tuesday due to Mars creating friction across your 1st and 10th Houses. Wear emerald green this week to amplify Venus's beauty in your sign. Follow for daily updates.
